maintenance_led.reason: Mostly cat litter (Cat's Pride, private label) and sorbents, which are consumables used up in normal use, not repair or maintenance.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from consumers and retailers buying cat litter, plus private industrial, agricultural and animal-health customers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling its own mined-mineral products; acquisitions are only occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Largest business is retail and private-label cat litter, which is easy to switch. Fluids purification and Amlan feed additives are smaller.
